$comment: The floor. Owned by CODEOWNERS (.github/CODEOWNERS), kept apart from test/suite.json on purpose: a PR that
drops or weakens a safety test has to touch this file too, which asks for the owner's review instead of
slipping through next to the change that made the test inconvenient.
`required`: must be listed under `tests` in test/suite.json (never `excluded`). run-tests.mjs --check fails otherwise.
`packed`: also run against the npm tarball (scripts/test-packed.mjs) before every publish — the 0.18.1
no-delete guarantees, checked on what users actually install rather than on the working tree.
Adding a name is always fine. Removing one needs a written reason in the PR and the owner's approval.
